sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Visual, Tactile) Wind Release, Fire Release, Clash

system.description:
You conjure super-heated chakra before firing a beam of white flame in a 30 feet long, 5 feet wide line. All creatures in its path must make a Constitution saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creatures take half of 3d8 fire damage.

Success: Affected creatures take half of 3d8 fire damage and are Dazzled until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures take 3d8 fire damage and are overwhelmed by the heat causing them to be Confused.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but affected creatures take 4d8 fire damage.

Scorch. By spending 2 Scorch Charges, this jutsu’s range instead becomes a 30-foot cone as the murderous flame fans out.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and damage by 1d8.
